en: A vintage-style colored postcard depicting a rural landscape with a dirt path or road winding through grassy and wooded terrain. A small red house or cottage is visible on the left, surrounded by trees, and a church spire can be seen rising above the treetops in the background. The skyline is mostly open sky. At the top left in red text are the words 'EESTIMAA. WÖSU. ESTLAND.' and overlaid in a blue-violet typewritten style are words in Estonian, possibly a holiday greeting and a date.
